{{Quote|&hellip;I'm afraid I must ask you to excuse me. I have some rather tricky negotiations to conclude with the Shahmistra of J'doytzin Three. One of those awkward conversations that can't be trusted to the Diplomatic Bureau.|Palpatine, to [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="CWGSe">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>}}
'''J'doytzin III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] negotiated with their [[Shahmistra of J'doytzin III|Shahmistra]]. The meeting was so tedious in Palpatine's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that he promised himself J'doytzin III would be among the first worlds to feel the wrath of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when it rose.<ref name="CWGSe" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that J'doytzin III was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
